stopper_list: S1 Company registered in Sweden; private persons cannot borrow; may apply before registration but the company must be registered before payout (https://www.almi.se/lan-finansiering/vanliga-fragor-om-lan/)

S2 Up to 249 employees and turnover at most 50 MEUR or balance sheet at most 43 MEUR (https://www.almi.se/lan-finansiering/innovationslan/ ; https://www.almi.se/lan-finansiering/vanliga-fragor-om-lan/)
S3 Applicant needs a residence permit, EU/EEA right of residence or Nordic citizenship (https://www.almi.se/lan-finansiering/vanliga-fragor-om-lan/)
S4 BankID, Mobilt BankID or Telia e-legitimation required; no application accepted without e-legitimation (https://www.almi.se/lan-finansiering/vanliga-fragor-om-lan/)

S6 Almi finances at most 50 percent of the estimated project cost: an 800,000 SEK project caps the loan at 400,000 SEK (https://www.almi.se/lan-finansiering/innovationslan/ ; https://www.almi.se/en/loan/innovation-loan/)

S7 Above 300,000 SEK at least half of the co-financing must be capital (equity, bank or other external funding): 200,000 SEK at a 400,000 SEK loan, which the angel money just covers (https://www.almi.se/lan-finansiering/innovationslan/ ; https://www.almi.se/en/loan/innovation-loan/)
S8 Own work counts toward co-financing only at lower loan amounts and only in some cases (https://www.almi.se/lan-finansiering/innovationslan/)

S9 Project must be a higher-risk innovation needing testing, verification or prototype work, with a clear development step contributing to long-term growth (https://www.almi.se/lan-finansiering/innovationslan/)

S10 Financial documentation mandatory: budget always; latest bokslut and current interim figures; if the bokslut is older than four months, income statement and balance sheet for the current year; cash-flow forecast (https://www.almi.se/lan-finansiering/forbered-detta/ ; https://www.almi.se/lan-finansiering/vanliga-fragor-om-lan/)

S11 Innovation-loan documents: description of the innovation and what is new, development plan and timeline, budget and financing plan, market and business model, prototypes or test results (https://www.almi.se/lan-finansiering/innovationslan/vanliga-fragor-om-innvovationslan-fran-almi/)

S12 Questions inside the form: capital need and amount, use, financing plan, ownership; for first-time borrowers business model, market and customers, team; for innovations customer need, how it was identified, how it is solved today, what is new, who is behind it; steps Ansökan lån, Verksamhet, Ekonomi, Företagsuppgifter, Förhandsgranska, Signera och skicka in (https://www.almi.se/lan-finansiering/sa-fungerar-almis-lan/ ; https://etjanster.almi.se/oversikt/overview/345)
S13 Kundkännedomsformulär required; the application is not complete without it (https://www.almi.se/lan-finansiering/sa-fungerar-laneprocessen/)
S14 Credit check on the applicant and the company's representatives (https://www.almi.se/lan-finansiering/sa-fungerar-laneprocessen/)
S15 Repayment capacity: a loan is granted only with a reasonable likelihood of repayment matching need and capacity (https://www.almi.se/lan-finansiering/vanliga-fragor-om-lan/)
S16 Collateral: often a company charge plus a limited personal guarantee, set case by case (https://www.almi.se/lan-finansiering/innovationslan/)
S17 Parts of the financing may fall under state-aid rules; prior public support must be reviewed (https://www.almi.se/en/loan/frequently-asked-questions-about-loan/loan-terms/)
S18 Starting point: the company cannot cover its whole capital need elsewhere, for example through a bank (https://www.almi.se/lan-finansiering/vem-kan-soka-almis-lan/)

B: Minor: lists 'Ett aktiebolag registrerat i Sverige' as a requirement; Almi's pages say any company (företag) registered in Sweden. No effect on this founder, who has an AB.

A: Eligibility condition 'yngre än 5 år, eller stöd av mindre betydelse på 3 år under 300 000 EUR' attached to Innovationslån: no Innovationslån or general loan page states it; the 300,000 EUR de minimis ceiling appears only on Almi's Verifieringsmedel page, a different program
B: 250 kr/hour valuation of own work and the derived example (600 h x 250 = 150k, budget 650k, cap 325k): from Driva Eget, a third-party source B itself labelled; no official Almi page gives an hourly rate
